title: Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒) Vol. 51 – Chinese Edition – Tong Li Comics
categoryName: Collectibles:Comic Books & Memorabilia:Manga & Asian Comics:Single Volumes
descriptionText:
Condition: Very Good – light shelf wear and mild yellowing consistent with age. Spine remains solid and uncreased, pages clean, no writing or tears (see photos).
Language: Traditional Chinese
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Publishing Co., Ltd.)
Series: 正式授權中文版 少年系列 (Official Licensed Chinese Shōnen Edition)
ISBN: 957-34-3667-1
Price on cover: NT$75 / HK$28
Description
This is Volume 51 of the popular martial arts comedy manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也), officially licensed and published in Taiwan by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社).
This later volume continues the fast-paced humor, martial arts battles, and comedic charm that defined the series’ long run. A must-have for collectors of vintage manga and fans of Tong Li’s early licensed shōnen titles.
